_README: Extra phrasings folded into an operator's embedded text at index time.
Texera's own descriptions are often three words ('join two inputs'), which
leaves the ranker little to match against. Each entry here adds the ways a
user would actually ask for that operator.
Key: the operator's userFriendlyName, exactly as the palette shows it.
Value: phrasings, in English. Write intents, not synonyms of the name --
'keep only rows that match a condition' helps; 'filtering' does not.
Entries for operators that do not exist are reported by the generator.
Filter: keep only rows that satisfy a condition
drop rows that fail a test
keep records where a value is above or below a threshold
select rows matching a where clause
Unnest String: flatten a nested structure into separate rows
expand an array field into one row per element
pull structured fields out of a nested object
Projection: keep only the columns you need
drop unnecessary columns from the output
Hash Join: combine two datasets on a shared column
match rows from two tables by a key
look up values from another table
Union: stack rows from two tables into one output
URL Fetcher: call a REST endpoint and read the response
download the contents of a web page by its address
request data from a third-party API
Distinct: keep only unique records and discard repeats
deduplicate rows that appear more than once
Limit: cap the number of rows that pass through
take only the first N records
truncate the output to a fixed size
Sort: order records by the value of a column
Aggregate: group records and compute a total per group
sum, average or count values per category
Split: divide one input into separate outputs
separate a column into several columns
Regular Expression: find text matching a pattern inside a column
extract substrings such as emails or phone numbers
validate that a field follows a format
Keyword Search: find records whose text contains a given word
search a column for a term or phrase
Type Casting: convert a column from one data type to another
change a field from text to number or date
